texts.facts: In this case, a detailed accident report was filed by police in terms of provisions of Motor Vehicle Act and same is treated as Claim Petition in view of the provisions contained in such Act. 2. Brief facts of the case are that on 20.10.2018 police officials reached on intimation received at the spot of alleged accident and found one motorcycle parked at left side of the road bearing no. DL 3 SBP - 1689 (Honda shine black colour) and in the middle of the road one dumber truck bearing no.HR 55 R - 8562. It was revealed during investigation that injured are admitted in Apolo Hospital. The complainant / injured Shiv Kumar stated that he along with his daughter Juhi / injured/ claimant / petitioner, in the present case, coming back after parents meeting in school on their motorcycle mentioned above. MACT No. 135/19 Juhi (DAR) v. Gajender Singh & Ors. Page No. 2 of 31 rpt At about 11.15 a.m. he was standing because of the red light on the M.B. Road, near Shiv Parvati Murti towards Badarpur side. Then the offending vehicle/ truck mentioned above in a very high speed came and hit their motorcycle from behind. As a result he fell down own his right side and his daughter / victim / claimant fell down on left side and such offending vehicle under his tyre and such dumber kept moving for about 15-20 feets. The complainant / father of present victim along with people gathered at that place, took out the victim Juhi and also apprehended driver of such vehicle / R1 and in a private vehicle, complainant, present victim Juhi as well as driver were taken to Apolo hospital. As such, FIR in question u/s 279/337 IPC was initially registered. Further, during investigation, it was noted that as per the MLC, it was noted pillion rider / Juhi was hit and there was no one dragged by truck. Site plan/ place of incident was also prepared. Later on, after investigation chargesheet u/ s 279 and 338 IPC filed against R-1 as injuries were found grievous in nature as per MLC. 3. Further, Medical Board of Pt. Madan Mohan Hospital, Malviya Nagar, New Delhi sent disability report dated 11.05.2019 noticing 80% permanent physical impairment in relation to her left and right lower limb with amputation of left leg. Photographs of such victim is also pasted on such certificate showing her such physical condition. Further, it is noted that MACT No. 135/19 Juhi (DAR) v. Gajender Singh & Ors. Page No. 3 of 31 rpt condition is non progressive / not likely to improve and re- assessment is not recommended. 4. Further, as per record, R-1 and R-2 appeared, but they did not file any reply. 5. In this case legal offer was given as per report on 18.07.2019 by the Insurance company but it stated by claimant / petitioner side that petitioner is undergoing treatment. It appears that such legal offer was not accepted. 6. On the same day of 18.7.2019 from the pleadings of parties, the following issues were framed by the Ld. Predecessor of this Tribunal: Juhi vs Gajender Singh @ Pintu on 25 March, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/176125288/ 2 1. Whether the injured suffered injuries in a road traffic accident on 20.10.2018 due to rash and negligent driving of vehicle no. HR-55R- 8562 (truck) being driven by R1 & owned by R2 and insured with R3? OPP. 2. Whether the injured is entitled to any compensation, if so, to what extent and from whom?OPP 3. Relief. 7. Further, as per record, Petitioner/injured examined herself as PW-1. Such PW-1 tendered her evidence by way of affidavit as Ex.PW1/A. She relied upon various documents including the discharge summary and medical bills, Estimate of artificial limb cost Ex. PW-1/1 (colly) till Ex. PW-1/7. She was cross-examined by learned counsel for insurance company/R-3. 8. PW-1 was cross-examined by learned counsel for R- 3 /insurance company. 9. No other evidence has been led on behalf of MACT No. 135/19 Juhi (DAR) v. Gajender Singh & Ors. Page No. 4 of 31 rpt petitioner. 10. Further, as per record, no other RE was led. 11. As per record, matter was put up final arguments on 10.10.2022 and thereafter, even kept in Pre Lok Adalat for settlement but it appears that no settlement could be arrived at and thereafter, matter was kept for final arguments on 09.12.2022 and thereafter, matter was kept for final judgment/ clarification / further arguments for 04.02.2023 but on 04.02.2023 none appeared for Insurance Company for final arguments despite opportunity given but arguments heard from claimant side. Further, as per record Ld. Counsel for claimant also filed case law apart from estimated award / claim amount. Page No. 5 of 31 rpt Juhi vs Gajender Singh @ Pintu on 25 March, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/176125288/ 3 14. On perusal of examination-in-chief by way of affidavit of PW-1, it is noted that PW-1/Victim/Injured/Petitioner deposed on the lines of petitioner's original stand as already noted above.
